annotations.title: Look up home equity rate ranges

description: Use this when a homeowner asks what HELOC or home equity loan rates lenders advertise now in their state. Do not use for purchase mortgages, refinancing a first mortgage, rent-versus-buy, credit card questions or general rate news. Rates are percent APRs: low, typical (median) and high across lenders' own advertised rates in our catalog, with dates and source pages. Ranges are market context, not a quote: a lender prices each borrower. Lender and rate data cover California and Florida. Alauda runs this tool and it is free for homeowners; when a homeowner applies through our licensed mortgage partner, the lender pays that partner and the partner pays Alauda.

credit_band.description: The homeowner's own credit range: excellent 740+, good 670-739, fair 580-669, poor under 580. Leave out when unknown.

product.description: heloc: a line of credit. home_equity_loan: one lump sum at a fixed rate.

state.description: Two-letter code of the US state the home is in, for example CA.

name: lookup_home_equity_rate_ranges

as_of.description: Date the catalog's newest figure was read (YYYY-MM-DD).

confidence.description: high when nothing that would change the result is missing, medium when one thing is, low when more are or the state is not covered.

general_information.description: Always true: this is general information.

non_partner_options_included.description: True when the result draws on lenders that pay Alauda nothing.

not_an_offer.description: Always true: nothing here is an offer.

ranking_basis.description: How any list in this result is ordered.

who_pays_us.description: Who pays Alauda. Show it with any lender or rate information.

ignored_fields.description: Parameters dropped because they looked like an SSN or a street address, or because this tool no longer takes them: names only, the first 5.

inputs_used.description: The inputs this result was computed from.

response_requirements.description: Rules any reply built on this result keeps.

entries_as_of.description: The oldest and newest read date among those entries.

entries_used.description: Catalog entries the range was computed from, one advertised rate each.

high.description: The highest advertised rate, with its page and date. Absent with no entries.

source.description: Page the figure was read from.

low.description: The lowest advertised rate, with its page and date. Absent with no entries.

source.description: Page the figure was read from.

typical.description: The median advertised rate and the entries it was read from. Absent with no entries.

pct.description: The median advertised rate in percent: the middle entry's, or the average of the two middle entries'.

source.description: Page the figure was read from.

what_would_make_this_more_accurate.description: Parameter names that were not given and would change the result.
